xmldoc.short_description: Create a figure for app-style user interfaces.

param_input_item.param_description: Figure property name-value pairs. uifigure applies MenuBar = 'none', ToolBar = 'none', NumberTitle = 'off', Resize = 'on', WindowStyle = 'normal', and a default 560-by-420 pixel size before user-supplied properties.

description.p: uifigure creates a graphics figure configured for interface-oriented dialogs and controls. The returned handle can be used with get, set, close, delete, and as the parent for UI dialog functions.
Supported properties are the figure properties available in Nelson, including 'Name', 'Position', 'Visible', 'WindowStyle', 'Resize', 'Color', 'Tag', and callback properties.

example_item.example_item_description: Captured UI figure for the help image.
Create a named modal UI figure.
